fieldValues.title: An affirmed remedy is a recorded ruling for a group's mandate
fieldValues.decision_question: May a working group auto-merge work that executes an affirmed remedy rather than a spec ruling, RFC or invariant?
fieldValues.context: 2026-10-16: WG Agent-supported editor's charter (384a704a) lets it auto-merge work that executes a recorded ruling, RFC or invariant. Its first issues (srs-web#566 to #572, the funding application objective) execute remedies the owner affirmed, which are client features with no spec ruling. Until this is decided the editor reviewer marks approved PRs gate:owner-merge.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Keep owner merge for all remedy work (safe, but every editor PR waits on the owner). Amend each charter to list the remedies it may execute (precise, but a charter edit per remedy). Do nothing (the editor group cannot auto-merge anything it is asked to build).
fieldValues.decision_statement: A remedy the owner has affirmed counts as a recorded ruling for a working group's mandate: a group may build and, with a valid quorum, auto-merge work that executes an affirmed remedy named in the issue and the PR, within its repositories and budget. Anything that changes a spec ruling, a public contract or a gate still escalates.
fieldValues.rationale: An affirmed remedy is the owner's recorded choice of a move, with a falsifier and a return condition; it is a ruling about what to build, made at the owner's level. Treating it as one lets groups act on the owner's priorities without a merge queue on the owner.
fieldValues.revisit_when: An auto-merged PR executing an affirmed remedy is reverted, or a remedy turns out to need a spec change.
